text:
Type: upholstered footstool on metal legs
Use: resting feet in front of a sofa, extra seating; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: beige-grey woven linen-look fabric, padded seat cushion, brushed chrome metal sled legs
Colors: warm greige, silver chrome
Shape: wide low rectangular cushion with rounded edges over a slim base, thin angular metal legs, light and raised, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, sleek, relaxed, soft
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, white walls, glass and chrome, light wood; contemporary or minimalist living rooms

product.name: NOCKEBY
product.description: You get extra soft comfort and support because the thick cushion has a core of pocket springs and a top of cut foam and polyester fibres.
